title: Strong is a feeling, not a size
headline: Strong is a feeling, not a size
caption:
Strength doesn't have a look. ✨

It's carrying the shopping up the hill without a second thought. It's getting down on the floor to play with the little ones, and back up again. It's a back that feels steady at the end of a long day.

That's the kind of strong we build at POWR, at your pace and in your body, whatever shape or age it is.

No comparing, no pressure: just a warm room on York Street and reformer Pilates in Clitheroe that meets you where you are.

Come and feel it for yourself. Book through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
